name: Tom cang song Son
summary: Tôm càng sông Son is the prawn the Quang Binh visitor portal’s 13 June 2025 article places in the rivers and streams of Phong Nha-Ke Bang. It lists grilled, salt-fried, steamed, and rim.
origin: Rivers and streams of Phong Nha-Ke Bang, in the Quang Binh visitor portal’s 13 June 2025 article.
texture: The 13 June 2025 article says the flesh is firm and sweet, and that the prawns are not fed industrial feed.
howToEat: The article lists grilled, salt-fried, steamed, and rim.
Phong Nha-Ke Bang National Park’s Mooc Spring page names mountain-stream shrimp on a platter and does not call them tôm càng.
A door, an hour, and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Phong Nha-Ke Bang rivers and streams. A shop address is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Tom cang song Son — prawns at Phong Nha
seoDescription: Tôm càng sông Son is grilled, salt-fried, steamed, or simmered. Mooc Spring’s shrimp are a separate line. A price is Check on arrival.
